characters.description: En fattig, sta ung mann med skulderveske som overlever trollets fire forbudte dører, går i lavparykk som foraktet gartnergutt og rir i hemmelighet til krigen i rusten rustning.

characters.name: Gartnergutten med lavparykken
characters.description: Enkesønnen i forkledning. Med en pjuskete parykk av grå granlav ser han ut som en som har overvintret i en grøft, og ingen på kongsgården kjenner ham igjen.

He wears a grubby, faded cornflower-blue quilted vest over a torn oatmeal hoodie, mud-stained dark-grey jeans and scuffed brown boots.

characters.name: Den fremmede rytteren
characters.description: Enkesønnen i den mest rustne rustningen fra trollets hus. Han rir til krigen på den svarte hesten når kongen er i knipe, og ingen vet hvem han er.
characters.look: A slim young man of about nineteen with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and a lock of glossy blue-black hair on his forehead, clad in an antique suit of plate armour blotched all over with orange-brown rust: a dented breastplate, jointed rusty arm and leg plates, a rusty mail collar and a round rusty helmet with the visor pushed up. characters.name: Den unge kongen
characters.description: Enkesønnen på bryllupsmorgenen, med prinsessa og halve riket. Han vil gi den svarte hesten alt den ønsker seg, men ikke det den ber om.
characters.look: A slim young man of about twenty with milk-pale skin, bright red cheeks, an oval face, a neat, narrow nose, big dark-brown eyes under thick level black eyebrows and short, glossy blue-black hair, wavy on top, with a cowlick at the crown, dressed for his wedding in a slim cornflower-blue suit, a crisp white shirt, a narrow dark-red tie, a small gold crown pin on the lapel and polished brown shoes.

characters.name: Den svarte hesten (den forheksede prinsen)
characters.description: En svart hest med menneskeøyne som står bundet i trollets hus, snakker, hjelper gutten å flykte og vinne krigen, og til slutt ber om å bli satt fri fra trolldommen.
characters.look: A big, powerful, coal-black horse with a glossy coat and no white markings at all, a long, thick, wavy mane and tail, a long forelock falling between his eyes, a proudly arched neck, a broad forehead, soft velvety nostrils, strangely human, clever amber-brown eyes, very expressive ears and shaggy black feathering over his big round hooves. characters.name: Trollet i den mørke bilen
characters.description: Et troll i menneskeskikkelse, rolig og høflig i mørk frakk, som plukker opp gutten langs veien, forbyr ham fire dører i et halvferdig hus i granskogen og straffer ulydighet hardt.

He has very long arms, huge knobbly hands and enormous flat feet in big black leather shoes, and wears a long black wool overcoat with large horn buttons, even indoors, over a dark-grey suit and a black roll-neck.

characters.name: Prinsessa
characters.description: Kongens datter, selvstendig og kvikk i joggesko, som ser gutten under lavparykken og holder fast på ham selv når hun får husarrest og mister telefonen.
characters.look: A lively, quick-witted young woman of twenty-three with a round, dimpled face, a small nose, bright hazel eyes, fair rosy skin and two long, heavy dark-brown plaits tied with rose-pink hair elastics. She wears a loose rose-pink knitted jumper, wide light-blue jeans, chunky white trainers with pink laces and a slim silver necklace with a small pink stone.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: En streng og mektig konge i mørk dress med hvitt lommetørkle i brystlomma, som styrer kongsgården med kameraer og væpnede vakter og til slutt kjenner igjen sitt eget lommetørkle.
characters.look: A broad, barrel-chested man in his fifties with a square, stern face, a big hooked nose, deep-set dark eyes under heavy black eyebrows and a thick, bushy black beard streaked with grey. He wears a dark bottle-green three-piece suit, a white shirt and a dark tie, a heavy gold signet ring, polished black shoes and, in his breast pocket, a crisp white handkerchief with a small crown embroidered in one corner.

places.name: the Royal Estate
places.look: A modern royal estate of glass and pale stone on a green slope above a bog and spruce forest: long, low wings with huge windows, clipped hedges, flower beds and a wide gravel driveway between two tall stone gateposts, each topped by a small black security camera, with another camera on every corner of the house. In the garden stands a tall, round glass summerhouse on steel posts with a spiral staircase. Behind a row of garages rises an old, round grey stone tower with one barred window.
